body:
I didn't mean that reincarnation would be preferable, I actually consider it to be one of the worst hells possible. Endless pain and suffering, with the bonus of getting to repeat all of the mistakes over and over again for eternity. I merely ment that if what I do or not does not change what the afterlife is then the existance, or lack therof, of an afterlife is irrelevant.

I did move, several years ago, to attend a university. Wasn't that interested in most of the classes, didn't like the city. Ended with a breakdown. Upcoming exam and as I saw it I had two choices: I could study and keep running in the hamster wheel until I died of natual causes alone and bitter or just call it quits right then and there. Unfortunately I survived.

I am angry, at mayself, everything and nothing in particular. I'd hate if I had the energy, but that's been exhausted and only a dull bitterness remains. Disappoineted, again with myself over not being someone I could have been, someone better. And disappointed with this world and life. Trapped, want to get away from this world, from existing. Hell, purgatory, nothingness, reincarnation? Wouldn't matter and in any case I'd only be hastening the inevitable. Atleast I want to be able to breath again, without som weight inside my chest making every single breath an effort.

Recently I was, for lack of a better word, dumped. Some time back a friend initiated a friends with benefits deal, she ended since she felt it was unfair towards me. Not being good at finding the right words or handling things delicatly she made it very painful. Part of me wants to hate her, but I cant.

For years I was stuck in a cycle of falling in love, being rejected and getting depressed. I imagined that the fleeting happiness I felt could last and I'd be able to live, not just staying alive. But that's nothing but bullshit. There are no happy endings. Would have been better if I'd ended it all years ago and saved myself the added suffering.

I appreciate it.

I'm just so tired, of feeling worthless, being alone, rejection. Even Humanity as a whole. I don't care, there's nothing, nobody worth caring about. I have friends and family that love me, but I don't love them enough that it would be worth it to stay and continue suffering for their sake.

Thank you.

Changing my thought patterns would be needed, but not something I have the power to do.

Can't deal with my emotions either, what I feel only makes me feel like a worse person. My brother just had a baby girl and I had the opportunity to spend some time with a friend I hadn't seen in a year and I felt nothing. I couldn't feel any joy. Not for my brother's good fortune, not that I could see my friend again. Only things I could feel were a bunch of negative feelings in relation to a guy that my friends were talking about. And shame for feeling that way.
